## Specification

### Component: HoverCard

A rich preview of a link, shown on pointer hover or keyboard focus. Supplementary only: it never opens on touch and holds nothing the person has to reach.

#### Anatomy
```
<HoverCard>                   context: open state, timers (useHoverIntent)
  <HoverCardTrigger />        <a> (or asChild) with data-state
  <HoverCardContent>          <div class="ui-floating ui-hover-card" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
    any content; helper classes .ui-hover-card-header .ui-hover-card-title .ui-hover-card-meta .ui-hover-card-text
```

#### Props
- `HoverCard`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `openDelay` (700), `closeDelay` (300).
- `HoverCardTrigger`: anchor props, `asChild`.
- `HoverCardContent`: `placement` (default `bottom`), `align`, `offset` (8), `arrow`, native div props.

#### Behaviour
- `pointerenter` (not touch) on the trigger starts a 700ms timer; leaving cancels it. Once open, leaving the trigger starts a 300ms close timer; entering the card cancels it; leaving the card restarts it.
- Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) on the trigger opens immediately. A mouse click focus does not.
- Focus moving from the trigger into the card (the card follows the trigger in the DOM) keeps it open; focus leaving both closes it after 300ms.
- Esc closes it, also while only hovering. Scrolling follows the trigger (useFloating).
- Positioning flips to the opposite side when there is no room and shifts into the viewport.

#### Visual rules
- Width 20rem, max `100vw − 1rem`, padding 16px, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface-raised`, `--ui-shadow-lg`, 14px text.
- Profile preview: avatar (lg) + name (600) + handle (muted, 13px) + action; bio 13px / 22px; meta line muted with a 16px icon.

#### Motion
- Open: `ui-pop-in` 220ms ease-out, 6px travel from the trigger side, scale .96, blur 2px. Close: `ui-pop-out` 160ms, pointer events off while closing.

#### Accessibility
- The trigger is a real link that works without the card; the card has no role and is not announced on hover.
- Interactive content inside is reachable by Tab.

#### Acceptance checks
- Not open at 350ms of hover, open by ~1.5s; card is 8px below the trigger.
- Moving the pointer to the card keeps it open; leaving closes it after about 300ms.
- Tab to the link opens it at once; Esc closes it; Tab into the card focuses its button.
- A touch `pointerenter` never opens it.
- No serious axe violations while open.

### `ui/components/hover-card/hover-card.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type AnchorHTMLAttributes,
  type FocusEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useHoverIntent } from '../../hooks/use-hover-intent';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

interface HoverCardContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  contentId: string;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  scheduleOpen: () => void;
  scheduleClose: () => void;
  openNow: () => void;
  closeNow: () => void;
  cancel: () => void;
}

const HoverCardContext = createContext<HoverCardContextValue | null>(null);

function useHoverCardContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(HoverCardContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <HoverCard>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface HoverCardProps {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the card asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Hover time before the card opens, ms. Default 700. */
  openDelay?: number;
  /** Time after the pointer leaves the trigger and the card before it closes, ms. Default 300. */
  closeDelay?: number;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * HoverCard — a rich preview of a link, shown on hover or keyboard focus.
 * It is a sighted-pointer convenience: it never opens from touch and holds
 * nothing essential (the trigger must work without it).
 */
export function HoverCard({
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  openDelay = 700,
  closeDelay = 300,
  children,
}: HoverCardProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const intent = useHoverIntent();

  const openNow = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    setOpen(true);
  }, [intent, setOpen]);
  const closeNow = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    setOpen(false);
  }, [intent, setOpen]);
  const scheduleOpen = useCallback(() => intent.start(openNow, openDelay), [intent, openNow, openDelay]);
  const scheduleClose = useCallback(() => intent.start(closeNow, closeDelay), [intent, closeNow, closeDelay]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      open,
      contentId: `${id}-content`,
      triggerRef,
      scheduleOpen,
      scheduleClose,
      openNow,
      closeNow,
      cancel: intent.cancel,
    }),
    [open, id, scheduleOpen, scheduleClose, openNow, closeNow, intent.cancel],
  );

  return <HoverCardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</HoverCardContext.Provider>;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** Only keyboard focus opens the card; a click also focuses the link and must not. */
function isKeyboardFocus(el: HTMLElement) {
  try {
    return el.matches(':focus-visible');
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

function leftBoth(e: FocusEvent, trigger: HTMLElement | null) {
  const next = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
  if (!next) return true;
  return !trigger?.contains(next) && !(e.currentTarget as Node).contains(next);
}

export interface HoverCardTriggerProps extends AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  /** Use your own link (a Next.js <Link>) as the trigger. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** The link or element that opens the card. Renders an `<a>`; give it an `href`. */
export const HoverCardTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, HoverCardTriggerProps>(function HoverCardTrigger(
  { asChild, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus, onBlur, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useHoverCardContext('HoverCardTrigger');
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, ctx.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLAnchorElement | null>);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'a';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={composed}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') ctx.scheduleOpen();
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') ctx.scheduleClose();
      }}
      onFocus={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onFocus?.(e);
        if (isKeyboardFocus(e.currentTarget)) ctx.openNow();
      }}
      onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        if (leftBoth(e, ctx.triggerRef.current)) ctx.scheduleClose();
        // focus moving into the card keeps it open; the card's own blur closes it later
        else ctx.cancel();
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type HoverCardContentProps = Omit<
  FloatingContentProps,
  'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
>;

/** The preview panel. Stays open while the pointer or focus is on it. */
export const HoverCardContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HoverCardContentProps>(function HoverCardContent(
  { placement = 'bottom', offset = 8, className, children, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onBlur, onFocus, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useHoverCardContext('HoverCardContent');

  // Esc closes it, also while only hovering
  useDismiss(ctx.open, [], ctx.closeNow, { outside: false });

  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.triggerRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      id={ctx.contentId}
      data-hover-card=""
      className={cn('ui-hover-card', className)}
      onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') ctx.cancel();
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') ctx.scheduleClose();
      }}
      onFocus={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onFocus?.(e);
        ctx.cancel();
      }}
      onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        if (leftBoth(e, ctx.triggerRef.current)) ctx.scheduleClose();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-hover-intent.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * One cancellable timer for hover intent (tooltip delays, submenu open/close).
 * Starting a new timer replaces the previous one; it is cleared on unmount.
 *   const intent = useHoverIntent();
 *   intent.start(() => setOpen(true), 700);   intent.cancel();
 */
export function useHoverIntent() {
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  const start = useCallback(
    (fn: () => void, delay: number) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fn();
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        fn();
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return useMemo(() => ({ start, cancel }), [start, cancel]);
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

```css
    max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-hover-card[data-side="bottom"] { --ui-pop-y: -6px; }
  .ui-hover-card[data-side="top"] { --ui-pop-y: 6px; }
  .ui-hover-card[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-hover-card[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-hover-card-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-hover-card-title { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25rem; }
  .ui-hover-card-meta { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.25rem; }
  .ui-hover-card-text { margin-top: 0.75rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.375rem; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

## Usage

**User preview** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/hover-card/user.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, getInitials } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger } from '@/ui/components/hover-card';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function HoverCardUser() {
  return (
    <p className="max-w-sm text-base">
      Release notes for 2.4 were written by{' '}
      <HoverCard>
        <HoverCardTrigger
          href="#ada-lovelace"
          className="font-medium text-foreground underline decoration-border underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-foreground"
        >
          @adalovelace
        </HoverCardTrigger>
        <HoverCardContent>
          <div className="ui-hover-card-header">
            <Avatar size="lg">
              <AvatarFallback>{getInitials('Ada Lovelace')}</AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="ui-hover-card-title">Ada Lovelace</p>
              <p className="ui-hover-card-meta">@adalovelace</p>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
              Follow
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="ui-hover-card-text">
            Engineering lead for the platform team. Writes about compilers, release engineering and calm
            interfaces.
          </p>
          <p className="ui-hover-card-meta mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Icon name="calendar" />
            Joined 12 March 2021 · 1,284 followers
          </p>
        </HoverCardContent>
      </HoverCard>{' '}
      and reviewed by the design systems group.
    </p>
  );
}
```
